briefings.title: Former Twitter CEO Parag Agarwal on X, Elon, & Building A New Internet For AI Agents | Mixed Signals
briefings.tldr: Former Twitter CEO and Parallel founder Parag Agrawal argues that AI agents will search the web 1,000x more than humans, creating a massive new agent-based internet economy that could help publishers monetize high-value traffic instead of relying solely on ads or subscriptions.

briefings.title: AI Agents Could Drive 10,000x More Web Activity | Former Twitter CEO
briefings.tldr: AI agents could drive 5,000x to 10,000x more web activity than humans, fundamentally transforming the internet from a reactive pull model to a proactive push model.

briefings.tldr: Parag Agrawal, CEO of Parallel Web Systems and former Twitter CEO, is building a web infrastructure specifically for AI agents, arguing that human click data is a bug and that agents will search the web 1,000 times more than humans.
